svg.title: Mission Frontier colony plan, top-down
svg.text: Colony plan, top-down (world XZ, +X right, +Z down = toward the camera). Cell pitch 108 m, hexagonal lattice, hub parcel at the centre.
Solid: parcels occupied at 3 projects (P1-P3). Dashed: growth slots P4-P8 with their bridges. Dotted: further slots. Land discs show plateau (r34), coast max (r46) and abutment pads.
camera looks along (-51,-46,-68); screen-right = u, screen-up = v
Fill order: P1 phi210, P2 phi330, P3 phi90, P4 phi150, P5 phi30, P6 phi270; ring 2 from P7 at phi90 (2D) outward.
Every bridge is the same 27.0 m span (18 deck panels) between abutment faces at r 40.5 of neighbouring cells.
All HQ fronts face +Z (toward the camera). Roads: ring road r 27.5-32.5 and six spurs to the pads.
